column1: # Brunei, MORA (Jabatan Mufti Kerajaan): the ministry's public SharePoint list for Bandar Seri
# Begawan (Brunei-Muara district, minutes = 0), captured 2026-09-25. The full-year file has 9
# duplicate/typo rows (the ministry's own list, research: "one would put Fajr about 9 min early");
# they are dropped in the "-clean" file used to fit. September was captured again independently on
# the same day and held out as a small forward check; it differs from the full-year file's own
# September rows by up to a minute on a few days (site noise), which is exactly why it is kept
# separate rather than folded into the fit. Belait, Tutong and Temburong's own minutes are
# documented (mora.gov.bn), not checked against a table: they stay unmeasured (Muis.kt).
